{{Citation}}
{{Quote|If this thing's a hoax, it's a kriffing good one. If you'll pardon the language, sir.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bas]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="HoT2">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Kriff''' was a vulgar [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|expletive]]. '''Kriffing''' was a derogatory modifier based on the word ''kriff''.

[[Kas'im]] used this expletive when he tried to argue with Qordis for restricting [[Darth Bane/Legends|his student's]] actions inside the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Academy]] and [[Republic soldier]]s frequently used this expletive when talking about the war on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="DB1">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> [[Johun Othone]] used the word ''kriffing'' when asking [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] to hire a security team, after having to fight off several armed kidnappers.<ref name="DB2">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]] referred to [[Carib Devist]] as a "kriffing clone" after realizing Devist had tricked [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] into sending him the then-secret location of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="HoT2" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] also used this word to refer to slicers when [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] refused to let him see the contents of a protected memory area, and had gone so far as to damage himself. Luke had forgotten that his young son [[Ben Skywalker]] was present, and when Ben asked Luke what ''kriffing'' meant, Luke remarked that Ben's [[Mara Jade Skywalker|mother]] would not be pleased that Ben overheard Luke using that word.<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> Captain [[Lon Shevu]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] used the word often when on raids, as well as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Abel G. Peña]] believes that [[Timothy Zahn]] created the word by reversing the "f" and the "k" from the term "frick," which is a synonym for "fuck."<ref name="SW.com">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=243200&start=360#15784824|thread=The Official Abel G. Peña Thread (Halagad Approved)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad]]|date=2006-10-13|time=6:19 PM|quote=I think Tim Zahn just reversed the k and f on the popular F-bomb substitute "frikkin."}}</ref>
